contract.name: G-FLOAT-LL-F64
contract.research_question: Complete original VALUE objects: finalized storage and independent-object PIPELINE time under equal CPU budgets on this fixed corpus.

corpus.exclusion_rule: No post-result exclusions; all promised members/configs remain in the fixed matrix.
corpus.name: G-FLOAT-LL-F64-real-core
corpus.sampling_design: Fixed local source corpus, two source families; related UTS/MTS windows remain the same independence unit. Exact integer representation defines the original typed i16 task, never a lossy cast route.
corpus.selection_rule: Predeclared first 8192 rows (or complete shorter source), first 4 original float/sensor channels or 2 named illness count fields, and first-channel UTS; no result-dependent selection.

method.name: ALP (forced decimal scheme, no ALP-RD fallback)
